tempo_note: tempo drifts ~136.4 BPM (intro) -> ~142 BPM (Drop 2); use beat_times, never a constant grid

sections.name: Cold open: pianissimo cello
sections.desc: solo cello, muted strings, a soft ticking 8th pulse; no low end (sub band ~-65 dB). The hook window.

sections.name: Intro A: strings enter
sections.desc: low strings + full string section at bar 5 (7.18 s); 8th-note string ostinato over an F# pedal (V of B minor), chromatic bass walk from ~19.5 s; ostinato stops ~23.3 s, then a rubato cymbal/string swell (bar 14 = 6 beats) into the boom

sections.name: Intro B: the boom and the build
sections.desc: low orchestral boom on bar 16 (27.24 s); lull bars 17-18 (sub drops out); orchestral build bars 19-26; bass drops out again bars 27-29 (46.5-51.7 s); full orchestra bars 30-38. Wordless choir swell ~41.5-42.9 s.

sections.name: Verse 1
sections.desc: hushed close lead vocal over the orchestra; first sung word 'The' at ~67.7 s (bar 39)

sections.name: Pre-chorus
sections.desc: 'A halo in the sky...': pickup 'A' at 89.2 s in bar 51; dread, tremolo strings, pulsing low 8ths

sections.name: Chorus 1
sections.desc: full orchestra + huge choir; syncopated orchestral hits; 'Throw down' 103.6 s; riser from ~108.0 s into the drop

sections.name: Drop 1 (8 bars)
sections.desc: orchestral EDM: four-on-the-floor kick from 110.57 s, sub bass, pumping strings, brass stabs. Chops: HALO / IN THE / SKY / SKY on the 4 beats of bar 64, then an 8th -> 16th stutter bars 65-67; bars 68-71 instrumental

sections.name: Drop 1 one-bar break
sections.desc: kick out for exactly one bar (124.48-126.21 s)

sections.name: Drop 1 (16 bars)
sections.desc: kick back on bar 73; bars 73-80 instrumental; bars 81-88 four 2-bar cycles of the sung chop (halo on beat 2, in the on beat 4, sky on beat 1, sky on beat 3)

sections.name: Breakdown
sections.desc: falls back to quiet: piano and soft strings, faint pulse (4 bars)

sections.name: Verse 2
sections.desc: 'What was it like...': piano + strings, faint pulse, close vocal

sections.name: 'Thales foretold...' build
sections.desc: strings + choir climbing; breath 187.65-188.55 s; '[rest]' 192.75-193.1 s; 'a sudden SPARK' lands on bar 113 (194.84 s) and the vowel is held ~5 s (194.9-200.2 s) as the orchestra swells: the diamond ring

sections.name: Final chorus (beat held back)
sections.desc: 'Shadow turned to day' 200.3 s; bright layer drops out 207.4-208.5 s; 'Throw down your blade' 208.7 s; low end OUT for bar 122 (210.18-211.88 s, held 'blade'); beat returns bar 123 with 'Home'; riser ~212.3 s -> drop

sections.name: Drop 2
sections.desc: fierce orchestral EDM drop, kick from 215.28 s; the topline is wordless sustained vocal (bars 125-133, 138-148); the shouted chops come at its end: THROW DOWN 256.41 / 257.25 (bar 149)

sections.name: Outro: stop-time hits, final chord
sections.desc: kick stops; hits on bars 150-153 with THROW DOWN 259.78 and BLADE 260.63; boom + held 'throw down' 262.7-266.1 s; ticking build; final stark chord 270.04 s decaying to silence by ~273.4 s

lines.text: The River Halys, on the sixth year of the war
Lydians and Medes, slew each other on the shore
Sun burning on the bronze exchange-
ing turns and strikes when light went strange.
A halo in the sky warriors awed
by the vacant eye of a god
Daylight turned to shade
eye of gods above
Throw down your blade
Go home to the ones you love
What was it like when reality suddenly broke
the silent eye, how the gods suddenly spoke
Birds went quiet, air suddenly cold
what we do next is how history unfolds
a shadow crossed the hills
the wind picked up a chill
Thales foretold the sun would go dark
Warriors behold … a sudden spark
Shadow turned to day
Sunlight from above
Throw down your blade
Home to the ones you love

chops.conf: medium: beat slot + unit onset; Whisper: 'the sky sky' over 111.5-112
high: unprompted Whisper on the isolated bursts hears 'I'm done!'; DTW best = 'throw down'
low: held note to ~266.1; unprompted Whisper 'I'm done'

drop_impacts.name: Drop 1 kick returns after the one-bar break
